x: Philip Goedluck ranked 20th in the 200m with 22.5, and Richard Allison's 400m County record of 49.9 was worth 18th spot one place behind a certain Ade Mafe.

At about 3.30 on Saturday afternoon, John Regis lined up alongside Linford Christie, Todd Bennett, Ade Mafe et al for the 200m final; 20.41 seconds later he was punching the air in celebration of a superb win.

Later in the day the final was won by Marcus in a blistering 20.10 and John recording a windy personal best of 20.16, back to his very best; and to complete Englands medal tally Ade Mafe finished third with 20.26 - a truly great race and one of the highlights of the Games for me.
Teaming up with Christie, Darren Braithwaite and Ade Mafe, John ran a storming 20.1 split for his leg in the 4 x 200 metres to not only beat the Americans again, but take the World Record in 1:22.11.
At Karlsruhe in Germany Ade Mafe relieved Regis of his 300m Commonwealth and British record of 33.22 with 32.90 and Marcus Adam placed 5th over 60m in 6.83.
